entities.name: Alandra
entities.description: Merfolk storm shaper from the Kapsho Seas on Shandalar, an ember invited to Strixhaven's first multiplanar class, who aspires to join Prismari.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: Alandra's home plane, where her father fights to hold the seas.

entities.name: Kapsho Seas
entities.description: Seas of Shandalar where Alandra is from.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: Plane whose dry conditions troubled Alandra.

entities.name: Talrand
entities.description: Alandra's father, whom she is to eventually succeed.

entities.name: Kasmina
entities.description: Professor who recruited five students to rob their sparks and presumably died in the confrontation.

entities.name: Vess
entities.description: Professor who decided the students' punishment.

entities.name: Prismari
entities.description: College of performance and passion Alandra aspires to.

events.summary: Kasmina recruits Alandra for Strixhaven having identified her as an ember.
events.quote: Alandra was recruited for Strixhaven by Professor Kasmina

events.summary: Alandra forms a class with Eula Blue, Segante, Jamira and Kequia Akosa on Arcavios.
events.quote: On Arcavios, Alandra formed a class with Eula Blue , Segante , Jamira , and Kequia Akosa .

events.summary: Kasmina's plot to force the five to ignite and steal their sparks is thwarted when they combine their powers; Kasmina presumably dies in the heart of a snarl.
events.quote: This plot was thwarted by the five students combining their powers

events.summary: Professor Vess lets the five stay and pledge to colleges, serving as residential advisors.
events.quote: She allowed them to stay on and pledge to their individual colleges
